name: Chesapeake Bay Trust Anne Arundel County Watershed Restoration and Forestry Grant Program
summary: Grants in Anne Arundel County, Maryland for watershed restoration design and implementation, reforestation and permanent protection of forested land. Funded with Anne Arundel County and the City of Annapolis.

geography.label: Anne Arundel County, Maryland, including the City of Annapolis

steps: Pre-application site visit with the Trust

status.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline is Friday, February 26, 2027 at 4PM ET

deadline.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline is Friday, February 26, 2027 at 4PM ET

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply: Non-profit organizations, land Trusts, land conservancies, community/homeowners' associations, faith-based organizations, and more.

geography.quote: Implementation project location: Anne Arundel County, Maryland INCLUDING the City of Annapolis.

window.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline is Friday, February 26, 2027 at 4PM ET

co_finance_required.quote: Match is encouraged, but not required.

effort.quote: The Trust requires that all applicants conduct a pre-application site visit with the Trust by February 12, 2027.
Deadline is Friday, February 26, 2027 at 4PM ET

documents.quote: with landowner permission documented through a Letter of Commitment included in your application.

eligibility.quote: applicants for Tracks 1, 2, 3, and 6 must be certified 501(c) non-profit organizations, except for homeowners or community associations located in the City of Annapolis.
Applications for Tracks 1, 2, 3, and 6 must include at least one partner that represents a stakeholder group based in Anne Arundel County.
All projects proposed shall be voluntary.

after_award.quote: If approved, the Trust will send an award agreement with award conditions and due dates of status, progress, and final reports.

eligibility.rule: Watershed, civic or faith groups on Tracks 1-3 and 6: certified 501(c) (Annapolis community associations exempt)
Watershed, civic or faith groups on Tracks 1-3 and 6: have an Anne Arundel County stakeholder partner
